summary.text: Timmy Beson is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 96 who has served since January 1, 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a small-business owner and sits on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Timmy Beson, whose given name is Timothy, was born in Bay City, Michigan, and graduated from John Glenn High School in 1992.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Saginaw Valley State University.
His career experience includes owning Beson's Market.
Beson has been assigned to the House Appropriations Committee in each term since taking office in 2021, including 2025 and 2026.
